attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT gateway on a new private network (10.50.50.0/24, eth1) so node2 and node3 (RHEL7), which have no internet access of their own on that network, can reach the internet through it. Assigned node1 eth1=10.50.50.254/24, added a persistent VyOS source NAT masquerade rule for 10.50.50.0/24 outbound via eth0, and statically addressed node2 (10.50.50.11) and node3 (10.50.50.12) eth1 interfaces via persistent RHEL ifcfg files. Verified end-to-end NAT via ping/curl and conntrack showing translated replies. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id, restarted each node one at a time via its native reboot mechanism, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and reverified NAT config/interfaces/connectivity after each restart.
